body:
I asked Claude code to find memory leaks. This is what I got.

- json_sax_dom_parser::insert_key_with_index: own the new object_key_index in a unique_ptr before key_indexes may reallocate; a throwing reallocation leaked it.
- basic_json::data(value_t): set m_type only after m_value is constructed. set_member() constructs a value in place over a null member; if allocating the object threw, the member was left as an object with a null pointer, which the enclosing object's destructor dereferenced.

- [x] The changes are described in detail, both the what and why.
- [ ] If applicable, an [existing issue](https://github.com/nlohmann/json/issues) is referenced.
- [ ] If applicable, a fixed [OSS-Fuzz](https://issues.oss-fuzz.com) issue is referenced as `OSS-Fuzz: <id>` (see [fuzz testing](https://github.com/nlohmann/json/blob/develop/tests/fuzzing.md#handling-oss-fuzz-reports)).
- [ ] The [Code coverage](https://coveralls.io/github/nlohmann/json) remained at 100%. A test case for every new line of code.
- [ ] If applicable, the [documentation](https://json.nlohmann.me) is updated.
- [x] The source code is amalgamated by running `make amalgamate`.

comments.body: Thanks for the feedback. Adjusted the commit.

title: Fix leak and crash when an allocation throws during parsing
